search_document: Reconcile the Stripe payout
Match yesterday's Stripe payout against the bank deposit and mark it reconciled in the finance sheet.
Open the Stripe dashboard and go to Payouts
Copy the latest payout amount and arrival date
Find the matching deposit in the bank statement
Enter the amount in the Payout Reconciliation Google Sheet and mark it reconciled

search_document: Submit the weekly expense report
Collect the week's receipts and submit an expense report in Expensify for approval.
Open Expensify and create a new report
Upload each receipt and set its category
Submit the report to the manager for approval

search_document: Post the daily standup
Write yesterday's progress, today's plan and blockers in the team's standup channel on Slack.
Open the #standup channel in Slack
Write what was done yesterday, today's plan and any blockers
Post the message

search_document: Review a pull request
Read a teammate's GitHub pull request, comment on the changed lines and approve or request changes.
Open the pull request on GitHub and read the description
Go through the Files changed tab and leave comments
Approve or request changes

search_document: Send the monthly client invoice
Create this month's invoice for the client in QuickBooks and email it.
Open QuickBooks and create an invoice for the client
Add the month's billable hours and check the total
Email the invoice to the client's billing address

search_document: Deploy to staging
Run the deploy script for the staging environment and check the logs and health page.
Strategy: Deploy from the main branch only after CI is green.
Pull the latest main branch in the terminal
Run ./deploy.sh staging
Watch the deploy logs for errors and open the staging health page

search_document: Book a meeting room
Find a free meeting room for a team meeting in Google Calendar and add it to the invite.
Open the event in Google Calendar
Click Rooms and pick a free room with enough seats
Save the event and notify the guests

search_document: Update a lead in the CRM
Log a sales call with a lead in HubSpot, update the deal stage and set a follow-up task.
Open the contact in HubSpot
Log the call notes
Move the deal to the next stage and create a follow-up task
